panel.summary: The MAX_REVIEW_ROUNDS bound the diff now relies on is erasable by the very agent it constrains (force-push resets it; the paging comment and label are deletable)
panel.evidence: The round bound counts commits currently on the PR whose lens checks failed (agent-review-panel.yml:335-343), and the comment at :329-332 calls it "unforgeable". But the fix job's App token has contents:write (line 379) and agent/ branches carry no protection — only `main` is verified protected (agent-implement.yml:82-118), and grep finds no ruleset covering agent/**. A single rebase/squash force-push replaces the SHAs the failed `agent-review-*` check runs are attached to, so `failedRounds` drops back to 0 and the autonomous loop restarts unbounded. "do NOT force-push" (line 426) is prompt text, not enforcement, and the same agent also holds issues:write, so it can delete the `<!-- agent-review-paged -->` latch comment (line 324) and remove the `agent:needs-human-review` label. Before this diff the fix step never ran, so the bound was never exercised; the `allowed_bots` addition is what makes it load-bearing.
panel.finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml::the max_review_rounds bound the diff now relies on is erasable by the very agent it constrains (force-push resets it; the paging comment and label are deletable)
